title: The Calendar Trick That Saves $30,000 on a Mortgage
hook_text: PAY THE SAME, SAVE FOUR YEARS

beats.say: A $200,000 mortgage at 7% for 30 years costs $280,000 in interest.
beats.visual: extreme wide shot of a suburban house at blue hour, sodium light from streetlamps casting long shadows

beats.say: Split that monthly payment in half. Pay it every two weeks instead.
beats.visual: extreme close-up of a checkbook, pen hovering over the payment line, low angle

beats.say: Same annual amount, but you make 26 payments a year, not 12.
beats.visual: silhouette of a calendar against a stormy sky, raindrops hitting the pages

beats.say: Most people think it’s the same as paying extra.
beats.visual: empty highway at night, headlights streaking in the distance, fog cutting the skyline

beats.say: But two extra payments a year shave 4 years off the loan.
beats.visual: high angle of a leather couch with a mortgage statement half-buried under mail, single practical light

beats.say: And save $30,000 in interest on that $200,000 loan.
beats.visual: cold fluorescent light over a kitchen table, mortgage documents scattered, pen circling a number

beats.say: How? Every extra payment chips away at the principal faster.
beats.visual: extreme close-up of a calculator, finger pressing the equals button, deep focus

beats.say: Lenders don’t tell you this because they’d rather keep the interest.
beats.visual: tower edge overlooking a city at dusk, sodium light reflecting off glass

beats.say: So why don’t more people do it?
beats.visual: wet asphalt at night, neon signs blurred in the background

beats.say: Because the math hides in plain sight on your payment calendar.
beats.visual: ridge line silhouetted against a setting sun, single tree on the horizon

beats.say: Same budget, same loan, but 4 years sooner you own it free and clear.
beats.visual: open water at dawn, single boat in the distance, mist rising off the surface

beats.say: This simple calendar tweak shaves four entire years off a 30-year mortgage using the exact same annual budget.
beats.visual: underpass with graffiti, sodium light bouncing off concrete, no faces

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: extreme close-up of a key in a lock, turning slowly, low angle

caption: Pay half your mortgage every two weeks. Own your home 4 years sooner. No extra cost.
description: Splitting your monthly mortgage payment into bi-weekly halves can cut 4 years off a 30-year loan and save tens of thousands in interest. Same annual budget, just a smarter calendar.
first_comment: Have you tried the bi-weekly payment trick? How much did you save?

facts.claim: A $200,000 mortgage at 7% for 30 years costs $280,000 in interest.
facts.basis: Standard amortization calculation for a 30-year fixed mortgage at 7% APR.

facts.claim: Bi-weekly payments on the same mortgage save 4 years and $30,000 in interest.
facts.basis: Amortization schedule for $200,000 at 7%: bi-weekly payments of $665.30 (half of $1,330.58 monthly) result in a 26-year repayment term and $250,000 total interest.

facts.claim: Bi-weekly payments result in 26 Half-payments annually (13 full monthly equivalents).

loop_map.stakes: A $280,000 interest cost on a $200,000 mortgage
loop_map.big_question: How can you pay the same amount and finish 4 years early?
loop_map.assume: Most people think bi-weekly payments are the same as monthly
loop_map.reveal: Bi-weekly payments add two extra payments a year, cutting 4 years off the loan
